name: Ascendance
description: Transform into a Flame Ascendant for 15 sec, instantly casting a Flame Shock and a 100% effectiveness Lava Burst at up to 6 nearby enemies.\n\nWhile ascended, Elemental Overload damage is increased by 75% and spells affected by your Mastery: Elemental Overload cause 1 additional Elemental Overload.

name: Earth Elemental
description: Calls forth a Greater Earth Elemental to protect you and your allies, generating high threat and taunting enemies periodically for 30 sec.

name: Astral Shift
description: Shift partially into the elemental planes, taking 40% less damage for 12 sec.

name: Spiritwalker's Grace
description: Calls upon the guidance of the spirits for 15 sec, permitting movement while casting Shaman spells. Castable while casting.

name: Wind Rush Totem
description: Summons a totem at the target location for 15 sec, continually granting all allies who pass within 10 yards 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec.

name: Capacitor Totem
description: Summons a totem at the target location that gathers electrical energy from the surrounding air and explodes after 2 sec, stunning all enemies within 8 yards for 3 sec.

name: Nature's Swiftness
description: Your next healing or damaging Nature spell is instant cast and costs no mana.

name: Stormkeeper
description: Charge yourself with lightning, causing your next 2 Lightning Bolts to deal 150% more damage, and also causes your next 2 Lightning Bolts or Chain Lightings to be instant cast and trigger an Elemental Overload on every target.

name: Ancestral Swiftness
description: Your next healing or damaging spell is instant, costs no mana, and deals 10% increased damage and healing.\n\nIf you know Nature's Swiftness, it is replaced by Ancestral Swiftness and causes Ancestral Swiftness to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.

name: Earthgrab Totem
description: Summons a totem at the target location for 20 sec. The totem pulses every 2 sec, rooting all enemies within 8 yards for 8 sec. Enemies previously rooted by the totem instead suffer 50% movement speed reduction.

name: Hex
description: Transforms the enemy into a frog for 1 min. While hexed, the victim is incapacitated, and cannot attack or cast spells. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1. Only works on Humanoids and Beasts.

name: Wind Shear
description: Disrupts the target's concentration with a burst of wind, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

name: Totemic Projection
description: Relocates your active totems to the specified location.

name: Voltaic Blaze
description: Instantly shocks the target and 5 enemies within 10 yds with blazing thunder, applying Flame Shock and dealing 1,511 Nature damage. Always critically strikes.\n\nGenerates 1 stack of Maelstrom Weapon.

name: Cleanse Spirit
description: Removes all Curse effects from a friendly target.

name: Chain Heal
description: Heals the friendly target for 875, then jumps up to 20 yards to heal the 3 most injured nearby allies. Healing is reduced by 30% with each jump.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing 278 Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Affects 3 total targets

name: Earth Shield
description: Protects the target with an earthen shield, increasing your healing on them by 20% and healing them for 332 when they take damage. This heal can only occur once every 3 sec. Maximum 9 charges.\n\nEarth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman.

name: Flametongue Weapon
description: Imbue your weapon with the element of Fire for 1 hour, increasing the damage of your Fire spells by 5.0%.

name: Frost Shock
description: Chills the target with frost, causing 279 Frost damage and reducing the target's movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

name: Healing Stream Totem
description: Summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec that heals an injured party or raid member within 40 yards for 254 every 1.8 sec.\n\nIf you already know Healing Stream Totem, instead gain 1 additional charge of Healing Stream Totem.

name: Lava Burst
description: Hurls molten lava at the target, dealing 525 Fire damage. Lava Burst will always critically strike if the target is affected by Flame Shock and its damage is increased by your critical strike chance.

name: Poison Cleansing Totem
description: Summons a totem at your feet that removes all Poison effects from a nearby party or raid member within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.

name: Spirit Walk
description: Removes all movement impairing effects and increases your movement speed by 60% for 8 sec.

name: Tremor Totem
description: Summons a totem at your feet that shakes the ground around it for 10 sec, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party and raid members within 30 yards.

name: Gust of Wind
description: A gust of wind hurls you forward.

name: Greater Purge
description: Purges the enemy target, removing 2 beneficial Magic effects.

name: Earth Shock
description: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force, causing 3,011 Nature damage.

name: Earthquake
description: Causes the earth within 8 yards of your target to tremble and break, dealing 1,433 Nature damage over 6 sec and has a 5% chance to knock the enemy down. Multiple uses of Earthquake may overlap.\n\nThis spell is cast at your target.

name: Elemental Blast
description: Harnesses the raw power of the elements, dealing 780 Elemental damage and increasing your Critical Strike or Haste by 3% or Mastery by 6% for 10 sec.

name: Purge
description: Purges the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.

name: Thunderstrike Ward
description: Imbue your shield with the element of Lightning for 1 hour, giving Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning a chance to call down 2 Thunderstrikes on your target for 271 Nature damage.

name: Astral Recall
description: Yanks you through the twisting nether back to your inn. Speak to an Innkeeper in a different place to change your home location.

name: Bloodlust
description: Increases haste by 30% for all party and raid members for 40 sec.\n\nAllies receiving this effect will become Sated and unable to benefit from Bloodlust or Time Warp again for 10 min.

name: Heroism
description: Increases haste by 30% for all party and raid members for 40 sec.\n\nAllies receiving this effect will become Exhausted and unable to benefit from Heroism or Time Warp again for 10 min.

name: Earthbind Totem
description: Summons a totem at the target location for 20 sec that slows the movement speed of enemies within 10 yards by 50%.

name: Thunderstorm
description: Calls down a bolt of lightning, dealing 57 Nature damage to all enemies within 10 yards, reducing their movement speed by 40% for 5 sec, and knocking them away from the Shaman. Usable while stunned.

name: Flame Shock
description:
Sears the target with fire, causing 86 Volcanic damage and then an additional 511 Volcanic damage over 18 sec.

Flame Shock can be applied to a maximum of 6 targets.

If Flame Shock is dispelled, a volcanic eruption wells up beneath the dispeller, exploding for 12,065 Volcanic damage and knocking them into the air.

name: Ancestral Guidance
description: For the next 10 sec, 25% of your healing done and 25% of your damage done is converted to healing on up to 3 nearby injured party or raid members, up to 6,110 healing to each target per second.

name: Ancestral Spirit
description: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 35% of maximum health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Downpour
description: A burst of water at your Healing Rain's location heals up to 5 injured allies within 12 yards for 1,247.

name: Fae Transfusion
description: Transfer the life force of up to 4 enemies in the targeted area, dealing 2,648 Nature damage evenly split to each enemy target over 2.7 sec. \n\nPressing Fae Transfusion again within 20 sec will release 60% of all damage from Fae Transfusion, healing up to 4 allies within 20 yds.

name: Far Sight
description: Changes your viewpoint to the targeted location for 1 min.

name: Flametongue Attack
description: Imbue your weapon with the element of Fire for 1 hour, increasing the damage of your Fire spells by 5.0%.

name: Ghost Wolf
description: Turn into a Ghost Wolf, increasing movement speed by 30% and preventing movement speed from being reduced below 100%.

name: Healing Surge
description: A quick surge of healing energy that restores 4,164 of a friendly target's health.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Hurls a bolt of lightning at the target, dealing 502 Nature damage.

name: Lightning Shield
description:
Surround yourself with a shield of lightning for 1 hour.

Melee attackers have a 100% chance to suffer 82 Nature damage.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at a time.

name: Primal Strike
description: An instant weapon strike that causes 11 Physical damage.

name: Primordial Wave
description: Blast your target with a Primordial Wave, dealing 241 Shadow damage and apply Flame Shock to an enemy, or heal an ally for 248.\n\nYour next Healing Wave will also hit all targets affected by your Riptide for 150% of normal damage.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Skyfury
description: Harness the fury of the Windlord to grant a target ally 2% Mastery and empower their auto attacks to have a 20% chance to instantly strike again for 1 hour.\n\nIf the target is in your party or raid, all party and raid members will be affected.

name: Stormstrike
description: Energizes both your weapons with lightning and delivers a massive blow to your target, dealing a total of 114 Physical damage.

name: Stormstrike Off-Hand
description: Energizes both your weapons with lightning and delivers a massive blow to your target, dealing a total of 114 Physical damage.

name: Surge of Earth
description: Consume up to 3 charges of Earth Shield to heal up to 3 allies near your Earth Shield target for 321 per charge consumed.

name: Water Walking
description: Allows the friendly target to walk across water for 10 min. Damage will cancel the effect.

name: Windfury Attack
description: Imbue your main-hand weapon with the element of Wind for 1 hour. Each main-hand attack has a 15% chance to trigger two extra attacks, dealing 9 Physical damage each.

name: Windlash
description: A massive gust of air that deals 416 Physical damage.

name: Windlash Off-Hand
description: A massive gust of air that deals 416 Physical damage.

name: Windstrike
description: Hurl a staggering blast of wind at an enemy, dealing a total of 123 Physical damage, bypassing armor.

name: Windstrike Off-Hand
description: Hurl a staggering blast of wind at an enemy, dealing a total of 124 Physical damage, bypassing armor.

name: Burrow
description: Burrow beneath the ground, becoming unattackable, removing movement impairing effects, and increasing your movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.\n\nWhen the effect ends, enemies within 6 yards are knocked in the air and take 2,508 Physical damage.

name: Static Field Totem
description: Summons a totem with 4% of your health at the target location for 6 sec that forms a circuit of electricity that enemies cannot pass through.

name: Counterstrike Totem
description: Summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec.\n\nWhenever enemies within 20 yards of the totem deal direct damage, the totem will deal 100% of the damage dealt back to attacker.

name: Lightning Lasso
description: Grips the target in lightning, stunning and dealing 14,630 Nature damage over 5 sec while the target is lassoed. Can move while channeling.

name: Grounding Totem
description: Summons a totem at your feet that will redirect all harmful spells cast within 30 yards on a nearby party or raid member to itself. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 3 sec.

name: Electrocute
description: When you successfully Purge a beneficial effect, the enemy suffers 2,154 Nature damage over 3 sec.

name: Shamanism
description: Your Heroism spell now has a 60 sec cooldown, but increases Haste by 15%, and only affects you and your friendly target when cast for 10 sec.\n\nIn addition, Heroism is no longer affected by Exhaustion.

name: Storm Conduit
description: Casting Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning reduces the cooldown of Astral Shift, Gust of Wind, Wind Shear, and Nature Totems by 1.0 sec.\n\nInterrupt duration reduced by 65% on Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning casts.

name: Totem of Wrath
description: Stormkeeper summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec that increases the critical effect of damage and healing spells of all nearby allies within 40 yards by 15% for 15 sec.

name: Aftershock
description: Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake have a 25% chance to refund all Maelstrom spent.

name: Amped Up
description: Increases your haste by 3%.

name: Ancestral Influence
description: Your Intellect is increased by 1.0% for each Ancestor active.

name: Ancestral Wolf Affinity
description: Cleanse Spirit, Wind Shear, Purge, and totem casts no longer cancel Ghost Wolf.

name: Ancient Fellowship
description: Ancestors have a 20% chance to call another Ancestor for 8 sec when they depart.

name: Arc Discharge
description: Tempest causes your next Chain Lightning to be instant cast, deal 40% increased damage, and cast an additional time.\n\nCan accumulate up to 2 charges.

name: Arctic Snowstorm
description: Enemies within 10 yds of your Frost Shock are snared by 30%.

name: Ascending Air
description: Wind Rush Totem's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec and its movement speed effect lasts an additional 2 sec.

name: Astral Bulwark
description: Astral Shift reduces damage taken by an additional 20%.

name: Awakening Storms
description: Stormstrike has a small chance to upgrade your next Lightning Bolt to Tempest.

name: Brimming with Life
description: Stamina increased by 8%.\n\nWhile you are at full health, Reincarnation cools down 50% faster.

name: Call of Fire
description: Ascendance summons a Greater Fire Elemental to rain destruction on your enemies for 20 sec. \n\nWhile the Fire Elemental is active, Flame Shock deals damage 33% faster, and newly applied Flame Shocks last 100% longer.

name: Call of the Ancestors
description: Unleash Life calls an Ancestor to your side for 12 sec.\n\nWhenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Ancestor will cast a similar spell.

name: Charged Conduit
description: Increases the duration of Lightning Rod by 4 sec and its damage bonus by 25%.

name: Conductive Energy
description:
Gain the effects of the Lightning Rod talent:

 Lightning Rod
Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning make your target a Lightning Rod for 8 sec.
 
Lightning Rods take 10% of all damage you deal with Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.

name: Crackling Fury
description: Voltaic Blaze's cooldown is reduced by 3 sec and its instant damage is increased by 50%.

name: Descending Skies
description: Casting Ascendance upgrades your next Lightning Bolt to Tempest.

name: Earthen Communion
description: Earth Shield has an additional 3 charges and heals you for 25% more.

name: Earthen Rage
description: Your damaging spells incite the earth around you to come to your aid for 6 sec, repeatedly dealing 160 Nature damage to your most recently attacked target.

name: Earthshatter
description: Increases Earth Shock and Earthquake damage by 8% and the stat bonuses granted by Elemental Blast by 25%.

name: Echo Chamber
description: Increases the damage dealt by your Elemental Overloads by 25%.

name: Echo of the Elements
description: Lava Burst has an additional charge.

name: Electroshock
description: Tempest increases your movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.

name: Elemental Fury
description: Your damaging critical strikes deal 250% damage instead of the usual 200%.

name: Elemental Orbit
description: Increases the number of Elemental Shields you can have active on yourself by 1.\n\nYou can have Earth Shield on yourself and one ally at the same time.

name: Elemental Resistance
description: Healing from Healing Stream Totem reduces Fire, Frost, and Nature damage taken by 6% for 3 sec.

name: Elemental Resonance
description: All Elemental damage increased by 3%.

name: Elemental Reverb
description: Lava Burst gains an additional charge and deals 10% increased damage.

name: Elemental Unity
description: While a Fire Elemental is active, your Fire damage dealt is increased by 6%.\n\nWhile a Storm Elemental is active, your Nature damage dealt is increased by 6%.

name: Elemental Warding
description: Reduces all magic damage taken by 8%.

name: Encasing Cold
description: Increases the cooldown of Frost Shock by 15 sec, but Frost Shock now freezes targets in place for 4 sec.

name: Enhanced Imbues
description: The effects of your weapon and shield imbues are increased by 30%.

name: Everlasting Elements
description: Increases the duration of your Elementals by 20%.

name: Eye of the Storm
description: Reduces the Maelstrom cost of Earth Shock and Earthquake by 5.\n\nReduces the Maelstrom cost of Elemental Blast by 10.

name: Feedback Loop
description: Elemental Overload damage increased by 35%.

name: Final Calling
description:
When an Ancestor departs, they cast Hydrobubble on a nearby injured ally.

 Hydrobubble
Surrounds your target in a protective water bubble for 15 sec.

The shield absorbs the next 1,795 incoming damage, but the absorb amount decays fully over its duration.

name: Fire and Ice
description: Increases all Fire and Frost damage you deal by 3%.

name: First Ascendant
description: The cooldown of Ascendance is reduced by 60 sec.

name: Flames of the Cauldron
description: Reduces the cooldown of Flame Shock and Voltaic Blaze by 1.5 sec.\n\nFlame Shock deals damage 15% faster.

name: Flames of the Firelord
description: Flame Shock damage increased by 100%.

name: Flash of Lightning
description: Increases the critical strike chance of Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 10%.

name: Fury of the Storms
description: Casting Stormkeeper summons a Greater Storm Elemental to hurl gusts of wind at your enemies for 10 sec.

name: Fusion of Elements
description: Consuming Power of the Maelstrom additionally fires an Elemental Blast at your target at 40% effectiveness.

name: Graceful Spirit
description: Reduces the cooldown of Spiritwalker's Grace by 30 sec and increases your movement speed by 20% while it is active.

name: Heed My Call
description: Ancestors last an additional 4 sec.

name: Herald of the Storms
description: Reduces the cooldown of Stormkeeper by 15 sec.

name: Inferno Arc
description: Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake deal 10% increased damage to targets affected by Flame Shock.

name: Instinctive Imbuements
description: Lightning Shield increases your Intellect by 3%.\n\nCasting Lightning Shield now applies your weapon imbuements. Earth Shield is also applied if you have the Elemental Orbit talent.

name: Jet Stream
description: Wind Rush Totem's movement speed bonus is increased by 10% and now removes snares.

name: Latent Wisdom
description: Your Ancestors' spells are 25% more powerful.

name: Lava Flows
description: Lava Burst damage increased by 5%.\n\nLava Burst and Lava Burst Overload generate 1 additional Maelstrom.

name: Lightning Capacitor
description: While Lightning Shield is active, your Nature damage dealt is increased by 8%.

name: Lightning Conduit
description: You have a chance to get struck by lightning, increasing your movement speed by 50% for 5 sec. The effectiveness is increased to 100% in outdoor areas.\n\nYou call down a Thunderstorm when you Reincarnate.

name: Lightning Rod
description: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning make your target a Lightning Rod for 8 sec.\n \nLightning Rods take 10% of all damage you deal with Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.

name: Maelstrom Supremacy
description: Increases the healing done by Healing Wave, Downpour, and Chain Heal by 25%.

name: Mana Spring
description: Your Lava Burst casts restore 22 mana to you and 4 allies nearest to you within 40 yards.\n\nAllies can only benefit from one Shaman's Mana Spring effect at a time, prioritizing healers.

name: Master of the Elements
description: Casting Lava Burst increases the damage or healing of your next Nature, Physical, or Frost spell by 15%.

name: Molten Wrath
description: Lava Burst deals 15% additional damage.

name: Mountains Will Fall
description: Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake can trigger your Mastery: Elemental Overload at 50% effectiveness.\n\nOverloaded Earthquakes do not knock enemies down.

name: Mystic Knowledge
description: Increases the chance for Lava Surge to occur by 20%.

name: Natural Gift
description: Nature damage is increased by 2%

name: Natural Harmony
description: Reduces the cooldown of Nature's Guardian by 15 sec and causes it to heal for an additional 10% of your maximum health.

name: Nature's Fury
description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature spells and abilities by 2%.

name: Nature's Guardian
description: When your health is brought below 35%, you instantly heal for 40% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 45 sec.

name: Nature's Protection
description: Lightning Shield reduces the damage you take by 3%.

name: Offering from Beyond
description: When an Ancestor is called, they reduce the cooldown of Riptide by 2 sec.

name: Path of the Seer
description: Increases your Intellect by 3%.

name: Planes Traveler
description: Reduces the cooldown of Astral Shift by 30 sec.

name: Power of the Maelstrom
description: Casting Lava Burst has a 15% chance to cause your next Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning cast to trigger Elemental Overload an additional time, stacking up to 2 times.

name: Preeminence
description: Your haste is increased by 25% during Ascendance and its duration is increased by 3 sec.

name: Primal Elementalist
description: Your Earth, Fire, and Storm Elementals are drawn from primal elementals 80% more powerful than regular elementals, with additional abilities, and you gain direct control over your Primal Fire Elemental.

name: Primordial Bond
description: Your Earth Elemental no longer taunts nearby enemies or generates threat and instead increases your maximum health by 15% while active.

name: Primordial Capacity
description: Increases your maximum mana by 10%.\n\nTidal Waves can now stack up to 3 times.

name: Primordial Fury
description: Elemental Fury increases critical strike damage by an additional 25%.

name: Purging Flames
description: Voltaic Blaze unleashes volcanic rage, causing your next Lava Burst to also fire at 5 additional targets with your Flame Shock at 80% effectiveness with reduced Maelstrom generation.\n\nLava Burst damage increased by 10%.

name: Reactive Warding
description: When refreshing Earth Shield, your target is healed for 830 for each stack of Earth Shield they are missing.\n\nAdditionally, Earth Shield can consume charges 1.0 sec faster.

name: Refreshing Waters
description: Your Healing Surge is 25% more effective on yourself.

name: Rolling Thunder
description:
Doom Winds summons a Nature Feral Spirit for 12 sec.

Feral Spirit
An Elemental Spirit infused with Nature magic, granting the summoner with 5% increased Nature damage and 5% Physical damage for 12 sec.

name: Routine Communication
description: Riptide has a 15% chance to call an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.

name: Searing Flames
description: Flame Shock damage has a chance to generate 2 Maelstrom.

name: Spirit Wolf
description: While transformed into a Ghost Wolf, you gain 5% increased movement speed and 5% damage reduction every 1 sec, stacking up to 4 times.

name: Spiritual Awakening
description: Mastery increased by 3%.

name: Spiritwalker's Aegis
description: When you cast Spiritwalker's Grace, you become immune to Silence and Interrupt effects for 5 sec.

name: Spiritwalker's Momentum
description: Using spells with a cast time increases the duration of Spiritwalker's Grace and Spiritwalker's Aegis by 1 sec, up to a maximum of 4 sec.

name: Static Charge
description: Reduces the cooldown of Capacitor Totem by 15 sec.

name: Storm Frenzy
description: Reduces the cast time of Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 15%.

name: Storm Infusion
description:
Elemental Resonance
All elemental damage is increased by an additional 2%.

 Thunderstrike Ward
Increases the chance for Thunderstrikes to occur by 30% and increases Thunderstrike damage by 75%.

name: Storm Swell
description: Tempest grants 7% Mastery for 6 sec.

name: Stormcaller
description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature damage spells by 5% and the critical strike damage of your Nature spells by 5%.

name: Stormwell
description: Storm Elemental lasts 2 sec longer, and Stormkeeper generates 10 Maelstrom.

name: Supercharge
description: Lightning Bolt, Tempest, and Chain Lightning have a 35% chance to refund 2 Maelstrom Weapon stacks.

name: Surging Currents
description: Casting Tempest grants Surging Currents, increasing the effectiveness of your next Chain Heal or Healing Surge by 16%, up to 80%.

name: Swelling Maelstrom
description: Increases your maximum Maelstrom by 50.\n\nIncreases Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake damage by 5%.

name: Tectonic Collapse
description: Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake deal 20% increased damage.

name: Tempest
description: Each Maelstrom Weapon spent has a 2.00% chance to upgrade your next Lightning Bolt to Tempest.

name: Therazane's Resilience
description: Earth Shield no longer loses charges and is 115% effective.

name: Thunderous Paws
description: Ghost Wolf removes snares and increases your movement speed by an additional 25% for the first 3 sec. May only occur once every 20 sec.

name: Totemic Focus
description:
Increases the radius of your totem effects by 15%.

Increases the duration of your Earthbind and Earthgrab Totems by 10 sec.

Increases the duration of your Healing Stream, Tremor, Poison Cleansing, and Wind Rush Totems by 3.0 sec.

name: Totemic Surge
description: Reduces the cooldown of most totems by 5 sec.

name: Unlimited Power
description: Spending Maelstrom Weapon stacks grants you 1% haste for 15 sec.\n\nMultiple applications may overlap.

name: Voltaic Surge
description: Crash Lightning and Chain Lightning damage increased by 15%.

name: Voodoo Mastery
description: Your Hex target is slowed by 70% during Hex and for 6 sec after it ends.\n\nReduces the cooldown of Hex by 15 sec.

name: Winds of Al'Akir
description: Increases your movement speed by 5% and the movement speed bonus of Ghost Wolf by an additional 5%.

name: Windspeaker
description: The cast times of Healing Surge, Chain Heal and Lava Burst are reduced by 10%.

name: Windveil
description: Interrupting a spell with Wind Shear reduces all spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.

name: Reincarnation
description: Allows you to resurrect yourself upon death with 20% health and mana. This effect can occur only once every 30 minutes.

name: Elemental Blast: Critical Strike
description: Critical Strike increased by $s1%.

name: Elemental Blast: Haste
description: Haste increased by $s1%.

name: Elemental Blast: Mastery
description: Mastery increased by ${$s1*$168534bc1}%.

name: Lava Surge
description: Flame Shock periodic damage has a chance to reset the remaining cooldown on Lava Burst and cause your next Lava Burst to be instant.

name: Wind Rush
description: Movement speed increased by $s1%.
